verdict.rationale: Reflect clearly documents end-to-end encryption of note contents that it cannot read ('not even us'), and its API docs confirm that its own servers cannot read note contents. Cross-device sync through Reflect's own service is only implied, by server-held encrypted notes plus iOS and Windows clients. One evidence item instead describes sync via iCloud Drive or Git, which is host-platform sync, and a community report says E2EE does not cover uploaded files and images. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an official cross-device sync service, E2EE coverage of attachments and images, independent hands-on confirmation of sync behavior.
